Verified live: table entities_geo has 533,291 rows and is queryable NOW at https://next.obudget.org/api/query?query=SELECT * FROM entities_geo — so it looks alive. But the ONLY pipeline that ever writes to it (`geocode` step, using processor geocode_entities, in datapackage_pipelines_budgetkey/pipelines/entities/pipeline-spec.yaml) is commented out in the live repo with the note '# Not used at the moment' and a dead crontab '0 0 fri * *'. git commit history for that exact file shows commit cb223af 'Remove entities-geo' on 2019-07-06T15:39:55Z — that's when the weekly re-geocode job was killed. Meanwhile entities/entities, entities/all, entities/fingerprints (the upstream org-registry pipelines) ran successfully TODAY (2026-07-16, per pipelines.obudget.org dashboard) — so new/changed orgs keep flowing into `entities` but are never geocoded into entities_geo. This DIRECTLY SUPERSEDES the prior note '533K pre-geocoded orgs' treated as usable geo layer: it is a static snapshot frozen ~7 years ago, not a refreshed feed. Any org registered/moved after mid-2019 is simply absent or has a stale address.
